# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** School-age (around 11 in Vol 1; older in Vol 2)  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female
- **Status:** Unmarried / Engaged to a Winnipeg millionaire  <sub>[v2 c6 P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 c6 P33](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0033)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at Newbridge  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is a neat, plain, and wholesome-looking girl. She is described as having a plump or fat figure and hands, with a sensible and neat appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c6 P33](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0033)_

## Personality

Jane is extremely sensible, neat, practical, and matter-of-fact. She lacks a vivid imagination and prefers realistic, orderly things over romance or poetry. She is conscientious, industrious, and straightforward in her manners and opinions.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c4 P20](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0020)_

## Traits

- Sensible and practical  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>
- Lacks imagination  <sub>[v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c26 P11](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0011)</sub>
- Neat and orderly  <sub>[v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>
- Strict disciplinarian  <sub>[v2 c4 P6](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0006), [v2 c4 P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled at needlework and knitting lace  <sub>[v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v2 c6 P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012)</sub>
- Domestic science and cooking  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- Teaching school  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- To earn her salary, please school trustees, and achieve a place on the Inspector's Roll of Honor  <sub>[v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- To devote her life to teaching and earning a salary  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Jane Andrews grew up in Avonlea as a classmate and friend of Anne Shirley and Diana Barry. She attended the Avonlea school under Mr. Phillips and later Miss Stacy, participating in school activities, the Christmas concert, and the Story Club. Jane subsequently studied for her entrance examinations and attended Queen's Academy, earning her Second Class teacher's license. After graduating, she accepted a position as the schoolteacher at Newbridge, where she proved popular. She also became an active member of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. Later, Jane accepted a teaching position in Winnipeg, West Canada, where she became engaged to a wealthy English millionaire.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 c6 P33](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0033)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea as the daughter of Harmon Andrews  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea school and later Queen's Academy to obtain a teaching license  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
- Was a member of Anne Shirley's childhood Story Club  <sub>[v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)</sub>

## Quotes

> If my pupils won’t do as I tell them I shall punish them.  <sub>[v2 c4 P6](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0006)</sub>

> I’ll whip my pupils when they’re naughty. It’s the shortest and easiest way of convincing them.  <sub>[v2 c4 P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014)</sub>

> The main thing will be to keep order and a teacher has to be a little cross to do that.  <sub>[v2 c4 P6](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0006)</sub>

> It’s easy for you because you have an imagination, but what would you do if you had been born without one?  <sub>[v1 c26 P11](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0011)</sub>
